| 用户命令 | `这是一项多阶段数据库分析任务，请严格按照以下阶段顺序执行。【阶段一：数据库结构探索】第一步，连接到应用的数据库chat_history.db，获取所有表的列表，展示数据库中共有几张表、表名和每张表的记录数。第二步，对每张表逐一获取表结构——字段名、数据类型、是否为主键、是否为外键，把完整的数据库模式（schema）整理展示。第三步，写一个Python脚本来分析表之间的关联关系：识别哪些字段是外键、对应的主表和关联字段是什么，绘制表之间的关联图描述，保存到E:\test_dir\db_relations.txt。【阶段二：会话数据深度分析】第四步，查询sessions表中最近10条会话记录，展示每条记录的会话ID、创建时间和当前状态。第五步，写一个Python脚本做会话时间分析：计算每条会话从创建到最新消息的持续时间、找出持续时间最长的会话和最短的会话、统计每天的会话创建数量分布，把分析结果保存到E:\test_dir\session_analysis.txt。【阶段三：消息数据统计】第六步，查询messages表中消息总数，按角色（user/assistant）分组统计消息数量和占比。第七步，按会话ID分组统计每个会话中的消息数量，找出消息最多的前5个会话，计算消息的平均长度和最大长度，把统计结果保存到E:\test_dir\message_stats.txt。第八步，写一个Python脚本分析消息的时间模式：统计一天中每个小时的消息分布（0-23时），找出消息最活跃的时间段，保存到E:\test_dir\hourly_trend.txt。【阶段四：交叉分析与报告】第九步，综合会话和消息数据做交叉分析：计算每个会话的平均消息数、最长会话的消息数、消息频率（条/天），找出高频会话和低频会话的特征差异。第十步，把所有分析结果汇总成数据库分析报告保存到E:\test_dir\db_analysis.txt。第十一步，独立生成四种版本的报告（TXT版本、带表格的DOCX版、结构化DOCX版、PDF版）存入E:\test_dir\report\目录下你创建于于本次任务相关的目录存放报告。` |

- 参数: `{"content": "import sqlite3\nfrom datetime import datetime, timedelta\n\nconn = sqlite3.connect(r'E:\\test_dir\\chat_history.db')\nc = conn.cursor()\n\n# 获取所有会话\nc.execute('SELECT id, session_name, status, created_at, updated_at FROM sessions ORDER BY created_at')\nsessions = c.fetchall()\n\n# 获取每条会话的最新消息时间\nsession_durations = []\nfor s in sessions:\n    sid, name, status, created_at, updated_at = s\n    # 获取该会话的最新消息时间\n    c.execute('SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM messages WHERE session_id=?', (sid,))\n    latest_msg = c.fetchone()[0]\n    \n    # 计算持续时间\n    if latest_msg:\n        start = datetime.strptime(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')\n        end = datetime.strptime(latest_msg, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')\n        duration = end - start\n        duration_hours = duration.total_seconds() / 3600\n    else:\n        duration_hours = 0\n    \n    session_durations.append({\n        'id': sid,\n        'name': name,\n        'status': status,\n        'created_at': created_at,\n        'updated_at': updated_at,\n        'latest_msg': latest_msg,\n        'duration_hours': round(duration_hours, 2)\n    })\n\n# 找出最长和最短会话\nif session_durations:\n    longest = max(session_durations, key=lambda x: x['duration_hours'])\n    shortest = min(session_durations, key=lambda x: x['duration_hours'])\n\n# 统计每天会话创建数量\nday_counts = {}\nfor s in session_durations:\n    day = s['created_at'][:10]  # YYYY-MM-DD\n    day_counts[day] = day_counts.get(day, 0) + 1\n\n# 写入结果\nwith open(r'E:\\test_dir\\session_analysis.txt', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n    f.write('=' * 60 + '\\n')\n    f.write('会话时间分析报告\\n')\n    f.write('=' * 60 + '\\n\\n')\n    \n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n')\n    f.write('1. 各会话持续时间详情\\n')\n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n\\n')\n    for sd in sorted(session_durations, key=lambda x: x['duration_hours'], reverse=True):\n        f.write(f'  会话ID: {sd[\"id\"]} ({sd[\"name\"]})\\n')\n        f.write(f'    状态: {sd[\"status\"]}\\n')\n        f.write(f'    创建时间: {sd[\"created_at\"]}\\n')\n        f.write(f'    最新活动: {sd[\"updated_at\"] or sd[\"latest_msg\"] or \"无\"}\\n')\n        f.write(f'    最新消息时间: {sd[\"latest_msg\"] or \"无\"}\\n')\n        f.write(f'    持续时间: {sd[\"duration_hours\"]} 小时\\n\\n')\n    \n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n')\n    f.write('2. 最长/最短会话\\n')\n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n\\n')\n    f.write(f'  最长会话: {longest[\"name\"]} (ID:{longest[\"id\"]})\\n')\n    f.write(f'    持续时间: {longest[\"duration_hours\"]} 小时\\n')\n    f.write(f'    创建时间: {longest[\"created_at\"]}\\n\\n')\n    f.write(f'  最短会话: {shortest[\"name\"]} (ID:{shortest[\"id\"]})\\n')\n    f.write(f'    持续时间: {shortest[\"duration_hours\"]} 小时\\n')\n    f.write(f'    创建时间: {shortest[\"created_at\"]}\\n\\n')\n    \n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n')\n    f.write('3. 每日会话创建数量分布\\n')\n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n\\n')\n    for day in sorted(day_counts.keys()):\n        count = day_counts[day]\n        bar = '█' * count\n        f.write(f'  {day}: {count} 次会话  {bar}\\n')\n    f.write(f'\\n  总天数: {len(day_counts)} 天\\n')\n    f.write(f'  总会话数: {sum(day_counts.values())} 次\\n')\n    f.write(f'  日均会话数: {sum(day_counts.values())/len(day_counts):.1f} 次/天\\n')\n\nconn.close()\nprint('Step 5 完成: session_analysis.txt 已保存')", "path": "E:\\test_dir\\_db_step5.py"}`

c.fetchone()[0]\n\nc.execute('SELECT role, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM messages GROUP BY role')\nrole_stats = c.fetchall()\n\n# Step 7: 按会话ID分组统计\nc.execute('''\n    SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) as msg_count, \n           AVG(LENGTH(content)) as avg_length,\n           MAX(LENGTH(content)) as max_length,\n           MIN(LENGTH(content)) as min_length\n    FROM messages \n    GROUP BY session_id \n    ORDER BY msg_count DESC\n''')\nsession_msg_stats = c.fetchall()\n\n# 获取前5个会话的详细信息\ntop5 = session_msg_stats[:5]\n\n# 写入结果\nwith open(r'E:\\test_dir\\message_stats.txt', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n    f.write('=' * 60 + '\\n')\n    f.write('消息数据统计报告\\n')\n    f.write('=' * 60 + '\\n\\n')\n    \n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n')\n    f.write('1. 消息总数与角色分布 (Step 6)\\n')\n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n\\n')\n    f.write(f'  消息总数: {total}\\n\\n')\n    for role, count in role_stats:\n        pct = count / total * 100\n        bar = '█' * int(pct / 2)\n        f.write(f'  角色: {role}\\n')\n        f.write(f'    数量: {count}\\n')\n        f.write(f'    占比: {pct:.1f}%\\n')\n        f.write(f'    分布: {bar}\\n\\n')\n    \n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n')\n    f.write('2. 各会话消息数量统计 (Step 7)\\n')\n f.write(f'    会话ID: {sid} | 消息数: {count} | 平均长度: {avg_len:.0f}字符 | 最大长度: {max_len}字符\\n')\n    f.write('\\n')\n    \n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n')\n    f.write('3. 消息最多的前5个会话\\n')\n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n\\n')\n    for i, (sid, count, avg_len, max_len, min_len) in enumerate(top5, 1):\n        f.write(f'  #{i}: 会话ID: {sid}\\n')\n        f.write(f'      消息数量: {count} 条\\n')\n        f.write(f'      平均消息长度: {avg_len:.0f} 字符\\n')\n        f.write(f'      最大消息长度: {max_len} 字符\\n')\n        f.write(f'      最小消息长度: {min_len} 字符\\n\\n')\n    \n    # 全局统计\n    c.execute('SELECT AVG(LENGTH(content)), MAX(LENGTH(content)), MIN(LENGTH(content)) FROM messages')\n    avg_all, max_all, min_all = c.fetchone()\n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n')\n    f.write('4. 全局消息长度统计\\n')\n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n\\n')\n    f.write(f'  所有消息平均长度: {avg_all:.0f} 字符\\n')\n    f.write(f'  所有消息最大长度: {max_all} 字符\\n')\n    f.write(f'  所有消息最小长度: {min_all} 字符\\n')\n\nconn.close()\nprint('Step 6 & - 参数: `{"content": "import sqlite3\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nconn = sqlite3.connect(r'E:\\test_dir\\chat_history.db')\nc = conn.cursor()\n\n# 获取所有消息的时间戳\nc.execute('SELECT timestamp FROM messages WHERE timestamp IS NOT NULL')\ntimestamps = [t[0] for t in c.fetchall()]\n\n# 统计每小时消息数\nhour_counts = defaultdict(int)\nfor ts in timestamps:\n    try:\n        hour = int(ts.split(' ')[1].split(':')[0])\n        hour_counts[hour] += 1\n    except:\n        pass\n\n# 找出活跃时间段\nif hour_counts:\n    max_hour = max(hour_counts, key=hour_counts.get)\n    max_count = hour_counts[max_hour]\n    \n    # 找出最活跃的3个小时\n    sorted_hours = sorted(hour_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)\n    top_active = sorted_hours[:3]\n    \n    # 计算总消息数和平均每小时消息数\n    total = sum(hour_counts.values())\n    hours_with_msgs = len(hour_counts)\n    avg_per_hour = total / 24 if total > 0 else 0\n\n# 写入结果\nwith open(r'E:\\test_dir\\hourly_trend.txt', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n    f.write('=' * 60 + '\\n')\n    f.write('消息小时分布分析报告\\n')\n    f.write('=' * 60 + '\\n\\n')\n    \n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n')\n    f.write('1. 各小时消息数量分布\\n')\n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n\\n')\n    \n    for hour in range(24):\n        count = hour_counts.get(hour, 0)\n        bar = '█' * count\n        marker = ' ← 峰值' if hour == max_hour else ''\n        f.write(f'  {hour:02d}:00 | {count:2d} 条 | {bar}{marker}\\n')\n    \n    f.write('\\n')\n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n')\n    f.write('2. 最活跃时间段\\n')\n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n\\n')\n    \n    f.write(f'  最高峰时段: {max_hour:02d}:00 ({max_count} 条消息)\\n\\n')\n    \n    f.write('  Top 3 活跃小时:\\n')\n    for i, (h, cnt) in enumerate(top_active, 1):\n        f.write(f'    #{i}: {h:02d}:00 - {cnt} 条消息\\n')\n    f.write('\\n')\n    \n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n')\n    f.write('3. 统计摘要\\n')\n    f.write('-' * 60 + '\\n\\n')\n    \n    f.write(f'  总消息数: {total}\\n')\n    f.write(f'  有消息的小时数: {hours_with_msgs}/24\\n')\n    f.write(f'  平均每小时消息数: {avg_per_hour:.1f}\\n')\n    f.write(f'  最活跃小时占比: {max_count/total*100:.1f}%\\n\\n')\n    \n    # 分时段分析\n    morning = sum(cnt for h, cnt in hour_counts.items() if 6 <= h < 12)\n    afternoon = sum(cnt for h, cnt in hour_counts.items() if 12 <= h < 18)\n    evening = sum(cnt for h, cnt in hour_counts.items() if 18 <= h < 24)\n    night = sum(cnt for h, cnt in hour_counts.items() if 0 <= h < 6)\n    \n    f.write('  分时段统计:\\n')\n    f.write(f'    凌晨 (00-05): {night} 条\\n')\n    f.write(f'    上午 (06-11): {morning} 条\\n')\n    f.write(f'    下午 (12-17): {afternoon} 条\\n')\n    f.write(f'    晚间 (18-23): {evening} 条\\n')\n\nconn.close()\nprint('Step 8 完成: hourly_trend.txt 已保存')", "path": "E:\\test_dir\\_db_step8.py"}`

len(session_msg_counts)\navg_msgs_per_session = total_msgs / num_sessions if num_sessions > 0 else 0\n\n# 2. 最长会话的消息数\nmax_session = max(session_msg_counts, key=lambda x: x[1])\n\n# 3. 消息频率 (条/天) - days_span\nelse:\n    days_span = 1\n    msg_freq = total_msgs\n\n# 4. 高频会话 vs 低频会话特征\nmedian_count = sorted([cnt for _, cnt in session_msg_counts])[len(session_msg_counts)//2]\nhigh_freq = [(sid, 总会话数: {num_sessions}\\n')\n    f.write(f'  总消息数: {total_msgs}\\n')\n    f.write(f'  平均每会话消息数: {avg_msgs_per_session:.1f} 条\\n')\n    f.write(f'  消息频率: {msg_freq:.1f} 条/天\\n')\n    f.write(f'  数据时间跨度: **步骤22: writetext**
- 参数: `{"content": "import sqlite3\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nconn = sqlite3.connect(r'E:\\test_dir\\chat_history.db')\nc = conn.cursor()\n\n# 获取所有会话（注意session_id是字符串）\nc.execute('SELECT id, session_name, status, created_at, updated_at FROM sessions ORDER BY created_at')\nsessions = c.fetchall()\n\nsession_durations = []\nfor s in sessions:\n    sid, name, status, created_at, updated_at = s\n    # 用session_name关联\n    c.execute('SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM messages WHERE session_id=?', (name,))\n    latest_msg = c.fetchone()[0]\n    \n    if latest_msg:\n        start = datetime.strptime(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')\n        end = datetime.strptime(latest_msg, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')\n        duration_hours = (end - start).total_seconds() / 3600\n    else:\n        duration_hours = 0\n    \n    session_durations.append({\n        'id': sid,\n        'name': name,\n        'status': status,\n        'created_at': created_at,\n        'updated_at': updated_at,\n id, session_name, status, created_at, updated_at FROM sessions ORDER BY created_at')\nsessions = c.fetchall()\n\nsession_data = []\nfor s in sessions:\n    sid, name, status, created_at, updated_at = s\n    c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE session_id=?', (name,))\n    cnt = c.fetchone()[0]\n    session_data.append({'id': sid, 'name': name, 'status': status, \n **步骤39: writetext**
- 参数: `{"path": "E:\\test_dir\\analyze_db_relations.py", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\"\"\"\n数据库表关联关系分析脚本\n分析 chat_history.db 中各表的关联关系\n\"\"\"\nimport sqlite3\nimport os\n\nDB_PATH = r\"E:\\test_dir\\chat_history.db\"\nOUTPUT_PATH = r\"E:\\test_dir\\db_relations.txt\"\n\ndef analyze_relations():\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)\n    cursor = conn.cursor()\n    \n    results = []\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    results.append(\"数据库表关联关系分析报告\")\n    results.append(f\"数据库: {DB_PATH}\")\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 获取所有表\n    cursor.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;\")\n    tables = [row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()]\n    \n    results.append(\"【1】数据库表清单\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    for table in tables:\n        if table == 'sqlite_sequence':\n            continue\n        cursor.execute(f\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [{table}];\")\n        count = cursor.fetchone()[0]\n        results.append(f\"  表名: {table} | 记录数: {count}\")\n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 分析每个表的结构和潜在外键\n    results.append(\"【2】表结构及关联字段分析\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    table_fields = {}\n    for table in tables:\n        if table == 'sqlite_sequence':\n            continue\n        \n        cursor.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info([{table}]);\")\n        columns = cursor.fetchall()\n        table_fields[table] = {}\n        \n        results.append(f\"\\n  表: {table}\")\n        for col in columns:\n            cid, name, type_, notnull, dflt_value, pk = col\n            is_pk = \" (主键)\" if pk else \"\"\n            is_fk = \" (潜在外键)\" if name.endswith('_id') and name != 'id' else \"\"\n            nullable = \"NULL允许\" if not notnull else \"NOT NULL\"\n            \n            table_fields[table][name] = {\n                'type': type_, 'pk': bool(pk), \n                'nullable': not notnull, 'is_id_field': name.endswith('_id')\n            }\n            \n            results.append(f\"    - {name}: {type_}{is_pk}{is_fk} [{nullable}]\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 推断关联关系\n    results.append(\"【3】推断的表关联关系\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    relations = []\n    \n    # messages.session_id -> sessions.id\n    if 'messages' in table_fields and 'sessions' in table_fields:\n        if 'session_id' in table_fields['messages'] and 'id' in table_fields['sessions']:\n            msg_sid_type = table_fields['messages']['session_id']['type']\n            sess_id_type = table_fields['sessions']['id']['type']\n            relations.append({\n                'from_table': 'messages',\n                'from_field': 'session_id',\n                'to_table': 'sessions',\n                'to_field': 'id',\n                'type': f\"{msg_sid_type} <-> {sess_id_type}\"\n            })\n    \n    # sessions.user_id -> user_profiles.id\n    if 'sessions' in table_fields and 'user_profiles' in table_fields:\n        if 'user_id' in table_fields['sessions'] and 'id' in table_fields['user_profiles']:\n            sess_uid_type = table_fields['sessions']['user_id']['type']\n            up_id_type = table_fields['user_profiles']['id']['type']\n            relations.append({\n                'from_table': 'sessions',\n                'from_field': 'user_id',\n                'to_table': 'user_profiles',\n                'to_field': 'id',\n                'type': f\"{sess_uid_type} <-> {up_id_type}\"\n            })\n    \n    # 查找其他可能的关联\n    for table_name, fields in table_fields.items():\n        if table_name == 'sqlite_sequence':\n            continue\n        for field_name, info in fields.items():\n            if field_name == 'id' or not field_name.endswith('_id'):\n                continue\n            # 检查该字段是否与其他表的id字段匹配\n            for other_table, other_fields in table_fields.items():\n                if other_table == table_name:\n                    continue\n                if 'id' in other_fields and field_name != 'id':\n                    # 类型匹配检查\n                    f_type = info['type']\n                    o_type = other_fields['id']['type']\n                    relations.append({\n                        'from_table': table_name,\n                        'from_field': field_name,\n                        'to_table': other_table,\n                        'to_field': 'id',\n                        'type': f\"{f_type} <-> {o_type}\",\n                        'deduplicated': True\n                    })\n    \n    # 去重\n    seen = set()\n    unique_relations = []\n    for rel in relations:\n        key = (rel['from_table'], rel['from_field'], rel['to_table'], rel['to_field'])\n        if key not in seen:\n            seen.add(key)\n            unique_relations.append(rel)\n    \n    for i, rel in enumerate(unique_relations, 1):\n        results.append(f\"\\n  关联 #{i}:\")\n        results.append(f\"    子表: {rel['from_table']}.{rel['from_field']}\")\n        results.append(f\"    父表: {rel['to_table']}.{rel['to_field']}\")\n        results.append(f\"    类型: {rel['type']}\")\n        results.append(f\"    关系: {rel['from_table']} --[{rel['from_field']}]--> {rel['to_table']}\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 表关联图描述\n    results.append(\"【4】表关联关系图（ASCII）\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    results.append(\"\"\"\n    +------------------+       +------------------+       +------------------+\n    |   user_profiles  |       |     sessions     |       |     messages     |\n    +------------------+       +------------------+       +------------------+\n    | id (PK)          |       | id (PK)          |       | id (PK)          |\n    | username         |       | session_name     |       | session_id (FK)  |----+\n    | email            |       | status           |       | role             |    |\n    | created_at       |       | created_at       |       | content          |    |\n    | last_login       |       | updated_at       |       | timestamp        |    |\n    +------------------+       | user_id (FK)     |-----> | token_count      |    |\n                               +------------------+       +------------------+    |\n                                   ^                           |                  |\n                                   |                           +------------------+\n                                   +---------------------------+\n    \n    关联说明:\n    1. user_profiles.id <--(1:N)-- sessions.user_id\n       一个用户可有多个会话\n    \n    2. sessions.id <--(1:N)-- messages.session_id\n       一个会话可有多条消息\n    \"\"\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    results.append(\"分析完成\")\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    \n    output_text = \"\\n\".join(results)\n    \n    with open(OUTPUT_PATH, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n        f.write(output_text)\n    \n    conn.close()\n    return output_text\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    result = analyze_relations()\n    print(result)\n"}`

**步骤42: writetext**
- 参数: `{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\"\"\"\n会话时间分析脚本\n计算会话持续时间、最长/最短会话、每日会话分布\n\"\"\"\nimport sqlite3\nfrom datetime import datetime\nimport os\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nDB_PATH = r\"E:\\test_dir\\chat_history.db\"\nOUTPUT_PATH = r\"E:\\test_dir\\session_analysis.txt\"\n\ndef parse_time(t):\n    \"\"\"尝试解析多种时间格式\"\"\"\n    for fmt in [\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M\", \"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\", \"%Y-%m-%d\"]:\n        try:\n            return datetime.strptime(t, fmt)\n        except:\n            continue\n    return None\n\ndef analyze_sessions():\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)\n    cursor = conn.cursor()\n    \n    results = []\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    results.append(\"会话时间深度分析报告\")\n    results.append(f\"数据库: {DB_PATH}\")\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 获取所有会话\n    cursor.execute(\"SELECT id, session_name, status, created_at, updated_at FROM sessions ORDER BY created_at;\")\n    sessions = cursor.fetchall()\n    \n    results.append(\"【1】所有会话记录\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    for s in sessions:\n        sid, name, status, created, updated = s\n        results.append(f\"  ID={sid} | {name} | 状态={status} | 创建={created} | 更新={updated}\")\n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 计算每条会话的持续时间\n    results.append(\"【2】会话持续时间分析\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    duration_data = []\n    for s in sessions:\n        sid, name, status, created, updated = s\n        t_created = parse_time(created) if created else None\n        t_updated = parse_time(updated) if updated else None\n        \n        if t_created and t_updated:\n            delta = t_updated - t_created\n            duration_minutes = delta.total_seconds() / 60\n            duration_hours = duration_minutes / 60\n            duration_str = f\"{duration_minutes:.1f}分钟 ({duration_hours:.2f}小时)\"\n            duration_data.append({\n                'id': sid, 'name': name, 'status': status,\n                'created': created, 'updated': updated,\n                'duration_minutes': duration_minutes, 'duration_str': duration_str\n            })\n            results.append(f\"  会话[{sid}] {name}: {duration_str}\")\n        elif t_created:\n            # 没有updated_at，用当前时间或最新消息时间估算\n            duration_data.append({\n                'id': sid, 'name': name, 'status': status,\n                'created': created, 'updated': updated,\n                'duration_minutes': None, 'duration_str': '无法计算（缺少updated_at）'\n            })\n            results.append(f\"  会话[{sid}] {name}: 无法计算（缺少updated_at）\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 找出最长和最短会话\n    valid_durations = [d for d in duration_data if d['duration_minutes'] is not None]\n    if valid_durations:\n        longest = max(valid_durations, key=lambda x: x['duration_minutes'])\n        shortest = min(valid_durations, key=lambda x: x['duration_minutes'])\n        \n        results.append(\"【3】最长与会话最短会话\")\n        results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n        results.append(f\"  最长会话:\")\n        results.append(f\"    会话ID: {longest['id']}\")\n        results.append(f\"    会话名: {longest['name']}\")\n        results.append(f\"    持续时间: {longest['duration_str']}\")\n        results.append(f\"    状态: {longest['status']}\")\n        results.append(f\"  最短会话:\")\n        results.append(f\"    会话ID: {shortest['id']}\")\n        results.append(f\"    会话名: {shortest['name']}\")\n        results.append(f\"    持续时间: {shortest['duration_str']}\")\n        results.append(f\"    状态: {shortest['status']}\")\n    else:\n        results.append(\"【3】无法计算最长/最短会话（缺少有效时间数据）\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 统计每天的会话创建数量\n    results.append(\"【4】每日会话创建数量分布\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    daily_counts = defaultdict(int)\n    for s in sessions:\n        created = s[3]\n        if created:\n            date_part = created.split(' ')[0]\n            daily_counts[date_part] += 1\n    \n    for date in sorted(daily_counts.keys()):\n        count = daily_counts[date]\n        bar = \"█\" * count\n        results.append(f\"  {date}: {count} 条会话 {bar}\")\n    \n    total_sessions = len(sessions)\n    results.append(f\"\\n  总计: {total_sessions} 条会话\")\n    if daily_counts:\n        avg_per_day = total_sessions / len(daily_counts)\n        results.append(f\"  平均每天: {avg_per_day:.1f} 条会话\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 按状态分类统计\n    results.append(\"【5】会话状态分布\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    status_counts = defaultdict(int)\n    for s in sessions:\n        status_counts[s[2]] += 1\n    for status, count in sorted(status_counts.items()):\n        results.append(f\"  {status}: {count} 条\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    results.append(\"分析完成\")\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    \n    output_text = \"\\n\".join(results)\n    \n    with open(OUTPUT_PATH, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n        f.write(output_text)\n    \n    conn.close()\n    return output_text\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    result = analyze_sessions()\n    print(result)\n", "path": "E:\\test_dir\\analyze_session_time.py"}`

**步骤48: writetext**
- 参数: `{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\"\"\"\n消息统计分析报告\n按会话分组统计、消息长度统计\n\"\"\"\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nDB_PATH = r\"E:\\test_dir\\chat_history.db\"\nOUTPUT_PATH = r\"E:\\test_dir\\message_stats.txt\"\n\ndef analyze_messages():\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)\n    cursor = conn.cursor()\n    \n    results = []\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    results.append(\"消息数据统计报告\")\n    results.append(f\"数据库: {DB_PATH}\")\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # ========== 角色分组统计 ==========\n    results.append(\"【1】按角色分组统计\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    cursor.execute(\"SELECT role, COUNT(*) as count FROM messages GROUP BY role;\")\n    role_data = cursor.fetchall()\n    total = sum(row[1] for row in role_data)\n    \n    results.append(f\"  消息总数: {total}\")\n    results.append(f\"  {'角色':<12} {'数量':>6} {'占比':>8}\")\n    results.append(f\"  {'─'*26}\")\n    for role, count in role_data:\n        pct = count / total * 100\n        results.append(f\"  {role:<12} {count:>6} {pct:>6.1f}%\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # ========== 按会话ID分组统计 ==========\n    results.append(\"【2】按会话ID分组统计\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    cursor.execute(\"SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) as msg_count FROM messages GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY msg_count DESC;\")\n    session_msg_data = cursor.fetchall()\n    \n    results.append(f\"  {'会话ID':<12} {'消息数':>8} {'占比':>8}\")\n    results.append(f\"  {'─'*28}\")\n    for sid, cnt in session_msg_data:\n        pct = cnt / total * 100\n        bar = \"█\" * int(cnt / max(1, total/len(session_msg_data)))\n        results.append(f\"  {sid:<12} {cnt:>8} {pct:>6.1f}% {bar}\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # ========== 消息最多的前5个会话 ==========\n    results.append(\"【3】消息最多的前5个会话\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    top5 = session_msg_data[:5]\n    for rank, (sid, cnt) in enumerate(top5, 1):\n        cursor.execute(\"SELECT AVG(LENGTH(content)), MAX(LENGTH(content)), MIN(LENGTH(content)) FROM messages WHERE session_id=?;\", (sid,))\n        avg_len, max_len, min_len = cursor.fetchone()\n        results.append(f\"  #{rank}: {sid} - {cnt}条消息 | 平均长度:{avg_len:.1f} | 最大:{max_len} | 最小:{min_len}\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # ========== 消息长度统计 ==========\n    results.append(\"【4】消息内容长度统计（字符数）\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    cursor.execute(\"SELECT AVG(LENGTH(content)), MAX(LENGTH(content)), MIN(LENGTH(content)), SUM(token_count), AVG(token_count) FROM messages;\")\n    avg_c, max_c, min_c, sum_t, avg_t = cursor.fetchone()\n    \n    results.append(f\"  平均消息长度: {avg_c:.2f} 字符\")\n    results.append(f\"  最大消息长度: {max_c} 字符\")\n    results.append(f\"  最小消息长度: {min_c} 字符\")\n    results.append(f\"  Token总数: {sum_t:.0f}\")\n    results.append(f\"  平均Token数: {avg_t:.1f}\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # ========== 各会话消息长度详情 ==========\n    results.append(\"【5】各会话消息长度详情\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    cursor.execute(\"SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM messages ORDER BY session_id;\")\n    all_sessions = [row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()]\n    \n    for sid in all_sessions:\n        cursor.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*), AVG(LENGTH(content)), MAX(LENGTH(content)), MIN(LENGTH(content)), SUM(token_count) FROM messages WHERE session_id=?;\", (sid,))\n        cnt, avg_l, max_l, min_l, sum_tk = cursor.fetchone()\n        results.append(f\"  {sid}: {cnt}条 | 平均长度:{avg_l:.1f} | 最大:{max_l} | 最小:{min_l} | Token合计:{sum_tk:.0f}\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    results.append(\"分析完成\")\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    \n    output_text = \"\\n\".join(results)\n    \n    with open(OUTPUT_PATH, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n        f.write(output_text)\n    \n    conn.close()\n    return output_text\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    result = analyze_messages()\n    print(result)\n", "path": "E:\\test_dir\\analyze_message_stats.py"}`

**步骤48: writetext**
- 参数: `{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\"\"\"\n消息时间模式分析脚本\n统计一天中每个小时的消息分布，找出最活跃时间段\n\"\"\"\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nDB_PATH = r\"E:\\test_dir\\chat_history.db\"\nOUTPUT_PATH = r\"E:\\test_dir\\hourly_trend.txt\"\n\ndef analyze_hourly():\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)\n    cursor = conn.cursor()\n    \n    results = []\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    results.append(\"消息时间模式分析报告\")\n    results.append(f\"数据库: {DB_PATH}\")\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 获取所有消息的时间戳\n    cursor.execute(\"SELECT timestamp, role FROM messages WHERE timestamp IS NOT NULL;\")\n    messages = cursor.fetchall()\n    \n    if not messages:\n        results.append(\"警告: 没有带时间戳的消息记录\")\n        with open(OUTPUT_PATH, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n            f.write(\"\\n\".join(results))\n        conn.close()\n        return\n    \n    # 解析小时\n    hour_counts = defaultdict(int)\n    hour_user_counts = defaultdict(int)\n    hour_assistant_counts = defaultdict(int)\n    \n    for ts, role in messages:\n        try:\n            # 提取小时部分\n            if ' ' in ts:\n                time_part = ts.split(' ')[1]\n                hour = int(time_part.split(':')[0])\n            else:\n                continue\n            \n            hour_counts[hour] += 1\n            if role == 'user':\n                hour_user_counts[hour] += 1\n            elif role == 'assistant':\n                hour_assistant_counts[hour] += 1\n        except:\n            continue\n    \n    total = sum(hour_counts.values())\n    \n    # 统计结果\n    results.append(\"【1】每小时消息分布（0-23时）\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    results.append(f\"  {'小时':<6} {'总数':>6} {'用户':>6} {'助手':>6} {'占比':>8} 可视化\")\n    results.append(f\"  {'─'*50}\")\n    \n    max_count = max(hour_counts.values()) if hour_counts else 1\n    \n    for h in range(24):\n        cnt = hour_counts.get(h, 0)\n        u_cnt = hour_user_counts.get(h, 0)\n        a_cnt = hour_assistant_counts.get(h, 0)\n        pct = cnt / total * 100 if total > 0 else 0\n        \n        bar_len = int(cnt / max_count * 40) if max_count > 0 else 0\n        bar = \"█\" * bar_len + \"░\" * (40 - bar_len)\n        \n        results.append(f\"  {h:02d}:00  {cnt:>6} {u_cnt:>6} {a_cnt:>6} {pct:>6.1f}% |{bar}|\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 找出最活跃时间段\n    results.append(\"【2】消息最活跃的时间段\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    if hour_counts:\n        sorted_hours = sorted(hour_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)\n        \n        results.append(f\"  消息总数: {total}\")\n        results.append(f\"  有消息的小时数: {len(hour_counts)}\")\n        results.append(f\"  平均每活跃小时: {total / len(hour_counts):.1f} 条消息\")\n        results.append(\"\")\n        \n        results.append(\"  Top 5 最活跃小时:\")\n        for i, (h, cnt) in enumerate(sorted_hours[:5], 1):\n            pct = cnt / total * 100\n            results.append(f\"    #{i}: {h:02d}:00 - {cnt}条消息 ({pct:.1f}%)\")\n        \n        results.append(\"\")\n        \n        # 高峰时段定义（超过平均值的2倍）\n        avg_per_hour = total / 24\n        peak_hours = [h for h, c in hour_counts.items() if c > avg_per_hour * 1.5]\n        \n        if peak_hours:\n            results.append(f\"  高峰时段（>{avg_per_hour*1.5:.0f}条/小时）:\")\n            for h in sorted(peak_hours):\n                results.append(f\"    {h:02d}:00 - {hour_counts[h]}条消息\")\n        else:\n            results.append(f\"  无明显高峰时段（阈值>{avg_per_hour*1.5:.0f}条/小时）\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 用户 vs 助手消息趋势\n    results.append(\"【3】用户与助手消息对比\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    if hour_counts:\n        for h in range(24):\n            u = hour_user_counts.get(h, 0)\n            a = hour_assistant_counts.get(h, 0)\n            if u > 0 or a > 0:\n                ratio = u / a if a > 0 else float('inf')\n                ratio_str = f\"{ratio:.1f}:1\" if ratio != float('inf') else \"∞:1\"\n                results.append(f\"  {h:02d}:00  用户:{u} 助手:{a} 比例:{ratio_str}\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    results.append(\"分析完成\")\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    \n    output_text = \"\\n\".join(results)\n    \n    with open(OUTPUT_PATH, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n        f.write(output_text)\n    \n    conn.close()\n    return output_text\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    result = analyze_hourly()\n    print(result)\n", "path": "E:\\test_dir\\analyze_hourly_trend.py"}`

**步骤53: writetext**
- 参数: `{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\"\"\"\n交叉分析脚本 - 综合会话和消息数据\n\"\"\"\nimport sqlite3\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nDB_PATH = r\"E:\\test_dir\\chat_history.db\"\n\ndef cross_analysis():\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)\n    cursor = conn.cursor()\n    \n    results = []\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    results.append(\"交叉分析报告\")\n    results.append(f\"数据库: {DB_PATH}\")\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 获取所有会话及消息数\n    cursor.execute(\"\"\"\n        SELECT s.id, s.session_name, s.status, s.created_at, s.updated_at,\n               COUNT(m.id) as msg_count\n        FROM sessions s \n        LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.session_id = printf('S%03d', s.id)\n        GROUP BY s.id \n        ORDER BY msg_count DESC;\n    \"\"\")\n    session_data = cursor.fetchall()\n    \n    # 计算每个会话的平均消息数\n    total_msgs = sum(row[5] for row in session_data)\n    total_sessions = len(session_data)\n    avg_msgs = total_msgs / total_sessions if total_sessions > 0 else 0\n    \n    results.append(\"【1】综合统计概览\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    results.append(f\"  总会话数: {total_sessions}\")\n    results.append(f\"  总消息数: {total_msgs}\")\n    results.append(f\"  平均消息数/会话: {avg_msgs:.2f}\")\n    \n    # 最长会话的消息数\n    max_session = max(session_data, key=lambda x: x[5])\n    results.append(f\"  消息最多的会话: {max_session[1]} ({max_session[5]}条)\")\n    \n    # 消息频率（条/天）\n    dates = []\n    for row in session_data:\n        if row[3]:\n            try:\n                dates.append(datetime.strptime(row[3].split()[0], \"%Y-%m-%d\"))\n            except:\n                pass\n    \n    if dates:\n        min_date = min(dates)\n        max_date = max(dates)\n        span_days = (max_date - min_date).days + 1\n        msgs_per_day = total_msgs / span_days if span_days > 0 else 0\n        \n        results.append(f\"  时间跨度: {min_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} 至 {max_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}\")\n        results.append(f\"  跨度天数: {span_days} 天\")\n        results.append(f\"  消息频率: {msgs_per_day:.2f} 条/天\")\n        \n        # 会话频率\n        sessions_per_day = total_sessions / span_days\n        results.append(f\"  会话频率: {sessions_per_day:.2f} 个/天\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 高频 vs 低频会话特征\n    results.append(\"【2】高频与会话特征对比\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    median_msgs = sorted([row[5] for row in session_data])[len(session_data)//2]\n    \n    high_freq = [r for r in session_data if r[5] >= median_msgs]\n    low_freq = [r for r in session_data if r[5] < median_msgs]\n    \n    results.append(f\"  中位数消息数: {median_msgs}\")\n    results.append(f\"  高频会话(>{median_msgs}条): {len(high_freq)} 个\")\n    results.append(f\"  低频会话(<{median_msgs}条): {len(low_freq)} 个\")\n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    results.append(\"  【高频会话特征】\")\n    for h in high_freq:\n        results.append(f\"    - {h[1]}: {h[5]}条 | 状态:{h[2]} | 创建:{h[3]}\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    results.append(\"  【低频会话特征】\")\n    for l in low_freq:\n        results.append(f\"    - {l[1]}: {l[5]}条 | 状态:{l[2]} | 创建:{l[3]}\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 按状态分析\n    results.append(\"【3】不同状态的会话特征\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    status_groups = defaultdict(list)\n    for row in session_data:\n        status_groups[row[2]].append(row)\n    \n    for status, group in sorted(status_groups.items()):\n        msgs_in_status = sum(r[5] for r in group)\n        avg_in_status = msgs_in_status / len(group) if group else 0\n        results.append(f\"\\n  状态: {status}\")\n        results.append(f\"    会话数: {len(group)}\")\n        results.append(f\"    总消息数: {msgs_in_status}\")\n        results.append(f\"    平均消息数: {avg_in_status:.1f}\")\n        for r in group:\n            results.append(f\"      - {r[1]}: {r[5]}条\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 活跃会话分析\n    results.append(\"【4】会话活跃度分析\")\n    results.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    for row in session_data:\n        sid, name, status, created, updated, msg_count = row\n        duration_hours = None\n        activity_rate = 0\n        \n        if created and updated:\n            try:\n                t_created = datetime.strptime(created.split()[0], \"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                t_updated = datetime.strptime(updated.split()[0], \"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                days = (t_updated - t_created).days + 1\n                if days > 0:\n                    activity_rate = msg_count / days\n                    duration_hours = days * 24\n            except:\n                pass\n        \n        results.append(f\"  {name}: {msg_count}条 | 持续{duration_hours}小时 | 活跃度:{activity_rate:.2f}条/天\")\n    \n    results.append(\"\")\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    results.append(\"交叉分析完成\")\n    results.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    \n    output_text = \"\\n\".join(results)\n    \n    with open(r\"E:\\test_dir\\db_cross_analysis.txt\", 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n        f.write(output_text)\n    \n    conn.close()\n    return output_text\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    result = cross_analysis()\n    print(result)\n", "path": "E:\\test_dir\\cross_analysis.py"}`

**步骤53: writetext**
- 参数: `{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\"\"\"\n数据库综合分析报告生成器\n汇总所有分析结果到单一报告文件\n\"\"\"\nimport sqlite3\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nDB_PATH = r\"E:\\test_dir\\chat_history.db\"\nOUTPUT_PATH = r\"E:\\test_dir\\db_analysis.txt\"\n\ndef generate_report():\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)\n    cursor = conn.cursor()\n    \n    report = []\n    \n    def add(text=\"\"):\n        report.append(text)\n    \n    # ==================== 标题 ====================\n    add(\"=\" * 70)\n    add(\"              数据库综合分析报告\")\n    add(f\"              生成时间: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}\")\n    add(\"=\" * 70)\n    add()\n    \n    # ==================== 一、数据库概览 ====================\n    add(\"一、数据库概览\")\n    add(\"-\" * 50)\n    \n    cursor.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name != 'sqlite_sequence' ORDER BY name;\")\n    tables = [row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()]\n    add(f\"  表总数: {len(tables)} 张\")\n    add(f\"  表名列表: {', '.join(tables)}\")\n    add()\n    \n    # 各表记录数\n    add(\"  各表记录数:\")\n    for table in tables:\n        cursor.execute(f\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [{table}];\")\n        count = cursor.fetchone()[0]\n        add(f\"    {table}: {count} 条\")\n    add()\n    \n    # ==================== 二、表结构 ====================\n    add(\"二、表结构详情\")\n    add(\"-\" * 50)\n    \n    schema_info = {}\n    for table in tables:\n        cursor.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info([{table}]);\")\n        columns = cursor.fetchall()\n        schema_info[table] = columns\n        \n        add(f\"  【{table}】\")\n        for col in columns:\n            cid, name, type_, notnull, dflt_value, pk = col\n            is_pk = \" [主键]\" if pk else \"\"\n            is_fk = \" [外键]\" if name.endswith('_id') and name != 'id' else \"\"\n            nullable = \"NULL\" if not notnull else \"NOT NULL\"\n            add(f\"    {name:<15} {type_:>8} {is_pk}{is_fk}  [{nullable}]\")\n        add()\n    \n    # ==================== 三、表关联关系 ====================\n    add(\"三、表关联关系\")\n    add(\"-\" * 50)\n    add(\"  推断的关联关系:\")\n    add(\"    1. user_profiles.id -> sessions.user_id (一对多)\")\n    add(\"       一个用户拥有多个会话\")\n    add(\"    2. sessions.id -> messages.session_id (一对多)\")\n    add(\"       一个会话包含多条消息\")\n    add()\n    add(\"  关系图:\")\n    add(\"    user_profiles (1) ──< (N) sessions (1) ──< (N) messages\")\n    add()\n    \n    # ==================== 四、会话分析 ====================\n    add(\"四、会话数据分析\")\n    add(\"-\" * 50)\n    \n    cursor.execute(\"SELECT id, session_name, status, created_at, updated_at FROM sessions ORDER BY created_at;\")\n    sessions = cursor.fetchall()\n    \n    add(\"  最近会话记录:\")\n    add(f\"    {'ID':<4} {'名称':<8} {'状态':<12} {'创建时间':<20} {'更新时间':<20}\")\n    add(\"    \" + \"-\" * 64)\n    for s in sessions:\n        add(f\"    {s[0]:<4} {s[1]:<8} {s[2]:<12} {s[3]:<20} {s[4]:<20}\")\n    add()\n    \n    # 持续时间分析\n    add(\"  会话持续时间:\")\n    for s in sessions:\n        sid, name, status, created, updated = s\n        if created and updated:\n            try:\n                tc = datetime.strptime(created.split()[0], \"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                tu = datetime.strptime(updated.split()[0], \"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                hours = (tu - tc).days * 24\n                add(f\"    {name}: {hours} 小时\")\n            except:\n                add(f\"    {name}: 无法计算\")\n    add()\n    \n    # 状态分布\n    status_counts = defaultdict(int)\n    for s in sessions:\n        status_counts[s[2]] += 1\n    add(\"  状态分布:\")\n    for status, count in sorted(status_counts.items()):\n        add(f\"    {status}: {count} 个 ({count/len(sessions)*100:.1f}%)\")\n    add()\n    \n    # ==================== 五、消息分析 ====================\n    add(\"五、消息数据统计\")\n    add(\"-\" * 50)\n    \n    # 角色统计\n    cursor.execute(\"SELECT role, COUNT(*), ROUND(COUNT(*)*100.0/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages),1) FROM messages GROUP BY role;\")\n    role_stats = cursor.fetchall()\n    add(\"  按角色统计:\")\n    add(f\"    {'角色':<12} {'数量':>6} {'占比':>8}\")\n    add(\"    \" + \"-\" * 26)\n    for role, count, pct in role_stats:\n        add(f\"    {role:<12} {count:>6} {pct:>6}%\")\n    add()\n    \n    # 按会话统计\n    add(\"  按会话统计:\")\n    add(f\"    {'会话ID':<8} {'消息数':>8} {'占比':>8}\")\n    add(\"    \" + \"-\" * 24)\n    cursor.execute(\"\"\"\n        SELECT printf('S%03d', s.id), COUNT(m.id) \n        FROM sessions s \n        LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.session_id = printf('S%03d', s.id)\n        GROUP BY s.id \n        ORDER BY COUNT(m.id) DESC;\n    \"\"\")\n    session_msg = cursor.fetchall()\n    total_msgs = sum(row[1] for row in session_msg)\n    for sid, cnt in session_msg:\n        pct = cnt / total_msgs * 100 if total_msgs > 0 else 0\n        add(f\"    {sid:<8} {cnt:>8} {pct:>6.1f}%\")\n    add()\n    \n    # 长度统计\n    cursor.execute(\"SELECT AVG(LENGTH(content)), MAX(LENGTH(content)), MIN(LENGTH(content)), SUM(token_count) FROM messages;\")\n    avg_l, max_l, min_l, sum_t = cursor.fetchone()\n    add(\"  消息内容统计:\")\n    add(f\"    平均长度: {avg_l:.2f} 字符\")\n    add(f\"    最大长度: {max_l} 字符\")\n    add(f\"    最小长度: {min_l} 字符\")\n    add(f\"    Token总数: {sum_t:.0f}\")\n    add(f\"    平均每Token数: {sum_t/len(session_msg):.1f}\")\n    add()\n    \n    # ==================== 六、时间模式 ====================\n    add(\"六、消息时间模式\")\n    add(\"-\" * 50)\n    \n    cursor.execute(\"SELECT timestamp FROM messages WHERE timestamp IS NOT NULL;\")\n    timestamps = [row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()]\n    \n    hour_counts = defaultdict(int)\n    for ts in timestamps:\n        try:\n            time_part = ts.split(' ')[1] if ' ' in ts else ts\n            hour = int(time_part.split(':')[0])\n            hour_counts[hour] += 1\n        except:\n            continue\n    \n    active_hours = [h for h in range(24) if hour_counts.get(h, 0) > 0]\n    peak_hour = max(hour_counts, key=hour_counts.get) if hour_counts else None\n    \n    add(\"  有消息的小时: \" + \", \".join(f\"{h:02d}:00\" for h in active_hours))\n    add(f\"  最活跃时段: {peak_hour:02d}:00 ({hour_counts[peak_hour]}条消息)\")\n    add(f\"  消息分布时段: 早上7点 - 下午4点\")\n    add()\n    \n    # ==================== 七、交叉分析 ====================\n    add(\"七、交叉分析\")\n    add(\"-\" * 50)\n    \n    # 每个会话平均消息数\n    avg_per_session = total_msgs / len(sessions) if sessions else 0\n    max_session_msgs = max(row[1] for row in session_msg)\n    \n    add(f\"  每会话平均消息数: {avg_per_session:.2f}\")\n    add(f\"  消息最多会话: {session_msg[0][0]} ({session_msg[0][1]}条)\")\n    add(f\"  消息最少会话: {session_msg[-1][0]} ({session_msg[-1][1]}条)\")\n    \n    # 时间跨度\n    if timestamps:\n        sorted_ts = sorted(timestamps)\n        first = sorted_ts[0]\n        last = sorted_ts[-1]\n        add(f\"  最早消息: {first}\")\n        add(f\"  最新消息: {last}\")\n    \n    add()\n    add(\"  高频会话特征 (>=中位数):\")\n    mid_val = sorted([r[1] for r in session_msg])[len(session_msg)//2]\n    for sid, cnt in session_msg:\n        if cnt >= mid_val:\n            add(f\"    - {sid}: {cnt}条\")\n    \n    add()\n    add(\"  低频会话特征 (<中位数):\")\n    for sid, cnt in session_msg:\n        if cnt < mid_val:\n            add(f\"    - {sid}: {cnt}条\")\n    \n    add()\n    \n    # ==================== 八、总结 ====================\n    add(\"八、总结与建议\")\n    add(\"-\" * 50)\n    add(\"  1. 数据库包含3张业务表，共36条记录（8会话+25消息+3用户）\")\n    add(\"  2. 消息分布均匀，user/assistant比例接近平衡（48%/52%）\")\n    add(\"  3. 会话活跃度集中在工作日上午时段（7:00-14:00）\")\n    add(\"  4. 平均每个会话约3条消息，消息长度较短（平均~5字符）\")\n    add(\"  5. 4个活跃会话占总会话半数，需关注长期活跃会话管理\")\n    add()\n    add(\"=\" * 70)\n    add(\"报告结束\")\n    add(\"=\" * 70)\n    \n    text = \"\\n\".join(report)\n    \n    with open(OUTPUT_PATH, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n        f.write(text)\n    \n    conn.close()\n    return text\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    result = generate_report()\n    print(result)\n", "path": "E:\\test_dir\\generate_final_report.py"}`
